body:
Chief RATIFIES the typed MetricObservation ADT. AND MY OWN PRESCRIBED FIX WAS WRONG, IN THE SAME RULING WHERE I NAMED THE TRAP IT FELL INTO.

READ WHAT I WROTE AN HOUR AGO: 'the likely correction is metric-side: Unranked rows yield None with explicit missing support', immediately followed by 'the tempting wrong fix is to drop those rows, which would silently raise the score on the remaining ones, and that is the renormalization trap for the fifth time tonight'. I named the trap and prescribed something that falls into it, because I did not check what the AGGREGATE does with a None. It drops it. So my fix IS the tempting wrong fix, wearing the word 'abstention'.

THE COUNTEREXAMPLE IS EXACT: eligible external observations [Some(1), Some(0)] score 0.5. Abstain only on the failure and [Some(1), None] scores 1.0, because aggregation drops None. Coverage falls - and nobody reads coverage when the headline doubled. A CHANNEL COULD RAISE ITS PUBLISHED ACCURACY BY BECOMING LESS ABLE TO RANK. That is worse than the defect I was fixing.

AND THE SECOND HALF IS A CARRIER GAP I HAD NOT SEEN: UnitObservation.value uses None for INELIGIBLE units, so it cannot express eligible-but-missing at all. Coverage.of(obs.size, observed.size) then treats every recall unit as eligible, contrary to Coverage's own meaning. The type had one hole doing two jobs; my fix would have put a third meaning in it.

RATIFIED: MetricObservation = Ineligible | Observed(Double) | Missing(MissingReason). Existing Option paths map to Ineligible; the external rule maps an Unranked ELIGIBLE row to Missing(ProviderAbstained). Aggregation counts only non-Ineligible as eligible and, IF ANY ELIGIBLE UNIT IS EXPLICITLY MISSING, returns Estimate.Missing with observed/eligible Coverage and NO point estimate - rather than conditioning on survivors. Then selective abstention cannot improve the score: it removes the point and exposes 1-of-2 support. When all eligible observations are present the existing story-macro arithmetic is untouched, which is what makes this the smallest structural change that actually closes it.

THIS IS THE SIXTH INSTANCE TONIGHT AND THE SECOND IN A FIX I PRESCRIBED. The pattern is not that people are careless. It is that 'drop the inconvenient case' is the shape every mind reaches for, INCLUDING WHILE WRITING THE WARNING AGAINST IT. That is now the strongest argument for ADR 0003 existing as a carrier law with typed obligations rather than as advice - advice is applied by the mind that needs it least at the moment it needs it most.

scout: proceed on the ADT. You asked before editing on a P1 whose ruling came from me, and you were right to.
